title: 「It is no use ／ no good + V-ing」表示做某事沒有用
titleZh: 「It is no use ／ no good + V-ing」表示做某事沒有用
titleEn: It is no use / no good + V-ing

source.file: Sentence Structure 243 - 「It is no use _ no good + V-ing」表示做某事沒有用.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit, together with the PDF's governing principles where applicable, is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card.
Where the PDF provides Chinese teaching content without a complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation and is labelled accordingly.
The source filename is numbered 243; it is assigned system ID ss244 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: It + be + no use / no good + V-ing + other information

formulas.formula: It + be + no use / no good + V-ing + other information
It was / will be / would be no use / no good + V-ing
Subject + know / realise / understand / explain + that + it + be + no use / no good + V-ing
Because / Since / If / When / Once / Unless + clause, + it + be + no use / no good + V-ing

example: It is no use blaming the staff.

examples.en: It is no use blaming the staff.
examples.highlight: It is no use blaming the staff.

examples.zh: 如果電池沒有電，不斷按按鈕也沒有用。
examples.highlight: If the battery is flat, it is no good pressing the button repeatedly.

meaning.zh: 表示某項行動無法改善情況、帶來預期結果或實際作用，繼續進行只會白費時間或力氣；它不一定表示行動在道德上錯誤。

rules.zh: no use 或 no good 後使用 V-ing，不使用 to + 動詞。
rules.en: Use V-ing after no use or no good, not to + verb.
examples: Incorrect: It is no use to complain.

rules.zh: 在本課目標意思中，no use 和 no good 都表示行動沒有實際作用；no use 較中性直接，no good 在口語中較常見、有時語氣稍強。
rules.en: In this target meaning, no use and no good both say that an action has no practical effect. No use is relatively neutral, while no good is common in speech and may sound slightly stronger.
examples: It is no use calling him.
It is no good calling him.

rules.zh: no 已帶否定意思，一般不要在前面再加 not。
rules.en: Do not add another negative before no, because no already carries the negative meaning.
examples: Incorrect: It is not no use worrying.

rules.zh: It is no good 亦可表示某物不好用，或某人不擅長某事；本課只練習 It + be + no good + V-ing。
rules.en: It is no good can also describe a poor object or lack of ability, but those meanings are outside this lesson. The target is It + be + no good + V-ing.
examples: He is no good at cooking.
It is no good buying that phone.

rules.zh: 題目可使用 There is no point in、It is pointless to、V-ing will not help、Do not bother 或 V-ing will achieve nothing，但答案須改用 It + be + no use ／ no good + V-ing。
rules.en: Prompts may contain There is no point in, It is pointless to, V-ing will not help, Do not bother or V-ing will achieve nothing, but model answers must use It + be + no use / no good + V-ing.

benefits.zh: 直接說明某個行動不能改善情況或帶來預期結果。
benefits.en: It states clearly that an action will not help or produce the desired result.

benefits.zh: 用一個清楚句型取代『某行動不會改變事情』等較長解釋。
benefits.en: It shortens a longer explanation by expressing the same idea through one clear structure.

benefits.zh: 可勸告別人停止浪費時間或力氣，適合提出實際建議。
benefits.en: It is useful for giving practical advice that someone should stop wasting time or effort.

benefits.zh: 能自然配合 because、if、unless、when 和 once，解釋某行動在甚麼情況下沒有用。
benefits.en: It helps explain reasons and conditions by connecting naturally with because, if, unless, when and once.

benefits.zh: 目標子句可放在句首、背景之後或轉述子句內，增加句子組織方式。
benefits.en: It gives several ways to organise a sentence because the target clause may appear first, after background information or inside a reported statement.

benefits.zh: 熟習框架後，可迅速加入 worrying、complaining、waiting 或 making excuses 等日常行動。
benefits.en: It provides a useful speaking frame into which many everyday actions can be inserted quickly.
